title: Selangor Marathon 2026 (SELMAR) Review: A Tourism Board's Race in Malaysia's Tech Hub
meta_description: Selangor Marathon 2026 review: November 1 at Persiaran Flora, Cyberjaya -- Tourism Selangor's marathon in Malaysia's Silicon Valley-styled tech city.
dek: Set for 1 November 2026 at Persiaran Flora, this state tourism board-backed marathon runs through Cyberjaya, a planned technology city adjacent to Putrajaya, aspiring to be Malaysia's Silicon Valley.
verdict: The Selangor Marathon (SELMAR) is organised directly by Tourism Selangor, giving it genuine state-level institutional backing rather than a purely commercial promoter -- a similar model to Bandar Lampung's railway-backed race, but here from a tourism authority rather than a transport utility. The route runs through Cyberjaya, Malaysia's purpose-built technology city established in 1997 as part of the Multimedia Super Corridor initiative, adjacent to and developed alongside Putrajaya. Two distances (42K/21K) keep it focused on serious distance runners rather than a broad family field.

sections.heading: A State Tourism Board's Marathon
paragraphs: The Selangor Marathon (SELMAR 2026) is organised directly by Tourism Selangor, offering two distances: the 42.195K full marathon and 21.1K half marathon, starting at Persiaran Flora, Cyberjaya. [1] That state-tourism-authority organisational model gives the event genuine institutional backing, distinct from the sportswear, beverage, fintech and bank sponsors covered elsewhere in this research.

sections.heading: Cyberjaya: Malaysia's Aspiring Silicon Valley
paragraphs: Cyberjaya is a planned city in Sepang District, Selangor, established on 17 May 1997 as part of Malaysia's Multimedia Super Corridor (MSC) initiative -- the country's first 'intelligent city,' designed to serve as its technology and innovation hub. [2] The name is a portmanteau of 'cyber' and 'Putrajaya,' reflecting its adjacency to and shared development history with Malaysia's administrative capital. With a 2020 population of just under 50,000 across 28.94 sq km, it hosts numerous multinational companies and data centres.

sections.heading: Marathon and Half Only
paragraphs: Unlike most races in this research batch, which offer a broad spread from 5K to full marathon, SELMAR sticks to just two serious distances: the full 42K and the 21K half. [1] That focus signals a race aimed squarely at committed distance runners rather than casual or family participants.

sections.heading: Wide, Modern Roads for Racing
paragraphs: As a purpose-built planned city adjacent to Putrajaya, Cyberjaya offers wide, modern boulevards well suited to marathon-distance racing -- similar in spirit to the purpose-built infrastructure seen at HSN Putrajaya and Garmin Run Malaysia's Putrajaya venue, both covered elsewhere in this research batch.

sections.heading: Should You Run It?
paragraphs: If a state-backed marathon through Malaysia's purpose-built tech hub appeals -- especially if you want a focused full or half marathon distance without a crowded field of shorter fun-run categories -- the Selangor Marathon on 1 November 2026 is a solid, institutionally credible pick. Registration is currently open.
